# TPC-DS-OBT Q11

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH year_total AS (SELECT obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id AS customer_id, obt.bill_customer_c_first_name AS customer_first_name, obt.bill_customer_c_last_name AS customer_last_name, obt.bill_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag, obt.bill_customer_c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country, obt.bill_customer_c_login AS customer_login, obt.bill_customer_c_email_address AS customer_email_address, obt.sold_date_d_year AS dyear, SUM(obt.ext_list_price - obt.ext_discount_amt) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id, obt.bill_customer_c_first_name, obt.bill_customer_c_last_name, obt.bill_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag, obt.bill_customer_c_birth_country, obt.bill_customer_c_login, obt.bill_customer_c_email_address, obt.sold_date_d_year UNION ALL SELECT obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id AS customer_id, obt.bill_customer_c_first_name AS customer_first_name, obt.bill_customer_c_last_name AS customer_last_name, obt.bill_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag, obt.bill_customer_c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country, obt.bill_customer_c_login AS customer_login, obt.bill_customer_c_email_address AS customer_email_address, obt.sold_date_d_year AS dyear, SUM(obt.ext_list_price - obt.ext_discount_amt) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id, obt.bill_customer_c_first_name, obt.bill_customer_c_last_name, obt.bill_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag, obt.bill_customer_c_birth_country, obt.bill_customer_c_login, obt.bill_customer_c_email_address, obt.sold_date_d_year) SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear, year_total AS t_s_secyear, year_total AS t_w_firstyear, year_total AS t_w_secyear WHERE t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 1998 AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1 AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 1998 AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN CAST(t_w_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 0) ELSE 0.0 END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0) ELSE 0.0 END ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag LIMIT 100
```
